scope: Four photographic textured additions, one original zebrafish reconstruction and one credited clownfish surface derivative. White and whale sharks reviewed on their retained existing assets. No independently validated physiology.

rheopresbe-kazika.author: ffish.asia / floraZia.com (https://sketchfab.com/ffishAsia-and-floraZia)
rheopresbe-kazika.changes: Original photographic image bytes, source UVs and indexed topology retained. Sculpin/goby/mullet surface coordinates are rigidly oriented and uniformly normalized, then share one authored axial skin across material boundaries. rheopresbe-kazika.biology: Qualitative exterior and locomotion illustration. No measured animal dimensions, fitted tailbeat rate, hydrodynamic propulsion, feeding, physiological gas exchange or independent scientific validation.

danio-rerio.title: Original reference-guided Zebrafish exterior
danio-rerio.author: PhenoVoxel Archive contributors (geometry/rig); Ffish.asia (CC BY4 photographic map)
danio-rerio.surfaceType: licensed whole photograph mapped onto original 3D flanks and unpaired fins
danio-rerio.changes: Original smooth body and attached fins with authored ratios, short barbels and a shared skeleton. The existing Ffish.asia CC BY4 photograph is retained unchanged as a texture; UV projection maps its flank onto both sides and its unpaired fin pattern onto the corresponding fin meshes. The opposite side mirrors the same individual pattern; unseen anatomy and optical responses are not independently reconstructed. Fin pigments, relief, iridescence approximation, joint angles and timing remain authored. Historical GLBs remain unchanged.
